ezinsar.eicomponents.processor.dorismodule.sensors.TSXspt

module documentation
(source)

Module to support TSX SPT data with Doris processor

The module allows to support TSX SPT data with Doris processor from an ezinsar.coregistration job.

(From ezinsar package)

def computefrqmatrixTSXSPT(leaderfile, outputfile, nb_lines, nb_pixels, log: bool | None = None, verbose: bool | None = None): (source) ¶

Compute the frequency matrix for TSX SPT-like imagery

The function computes the frequency matrix for TSX SPT-like imagery. It requires for the cc6p_SP algorithm.

Parameters
leaderfile:strpath of the leader file
outputfile:strpath of the output raw file
nb_lines:intNumber of lines
nb_pixels:intNumber of pixels
log:boollog [Default: None].
verbose:boolverbose [Default: None].
